description_en: Modifies the protection status of Web Application Firewall (WAF)
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-pause-protection-status --instance-id waf-cn-tl32ast0000 --pause-status 0 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyPauseProtectionStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to pause WAF protection.

0 (default): WAF protection is not paused.

1: WAF protection is paused
parameters.help_zh:
暂停WAF防护状态。

0（默认）：表示未暂停WAF防护。
1：表示已暂停WAF防护
parameters.name: pause_status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id
